# All Pro Collision

> Auto body and collision repair shop in Doraville, Georgia, serving metro Atlanta.

## Facts
- Business type: auto body shop (collision repair)
- Location: 3588 Oakcliff Rd STE B
- Phone: (770) 416-9660
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM; closed weekends
- Estimates: free, in person or from photos
- Insurance: works with all insurance companies; Georgia drivers may choose their own repair shop

## Services
- Collision repair (front, rear, and side impact)
- Auto painting and factory color matching
- Dent repair
- Bumper repair and replacement
- Frame and structural straightening
- Insurance claim assistance and supplements

## Service area
Doraville, Chamblee, Dunwoody, Brookhaven, Norcross, Peachtree Corners, Tucker, Atlanta
